props.text: A cream bath at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak is an Indonesian hair and scalp treatment: nourishing hair cream, a gentle scalp massage, a rinse and a finish. Most formulas are IDR 165.000 per person (L'Oreal is IDR 195.000), at our spa or at your villa or hotel. It's a popular choice after sun, salt water and swimming.

props.title: What Is a Cream Bath?
props.text: A cream bath is a popular Indonesian hair and scalp treatment that combines nourishing hair cream with a gentle scalp massage. Unlike a regular hair mask, it cares for the scalp as well as the hair, leaving it softer and better conditioned. It's a relaxing way to care for your hair after sun, swimming or frequent styling.
props.feature1Text: Nourishing ingredients help improve hair softness, hydration, and manageability.
props.feature2Text: Gentle massage movements support scalp comfort while enhancing relaxation.

props.title: Cream Bath Packages in Seminyak
props.text: Each of our four cream bath packages adds a Thai, Balinese or hot stone massage and a Bali Moon Facial, reflexology or body scrub.

props.title: Cream Bath and Hair Mask Options
props.text: Choose from five cream bath formulas or a hair mask. Each includes cleansing, conditioning and a relaxing head massage; the price depends on the product.

props.title: Choose Your Cream Bath Formula
props.text: Each cream uses different ingredients. Depending on your hair, you may prefer:
featuresLeft: Aloe Vera to soothe the scalp
featuresRight: L'Oreal for smoother, more manageable hair

Hair Mask for conditioning through the lengths

props.title: How a Cream Bath Cares for Your Hair
props.text: A cream bath helps hair that sun, salt water, swimming or styling has dried out. Benefits may include:
featuresLeft: Helps improve hair moisture and softness
Helps reduce the look of dryness and frizz
featuresRight: Leaves hair feeling refreshed and easier to manage
Provides gentle care for the scalp
Enhances shine and overall hair comfort

props.title: Inside a Cream Bath Session
props.text: Your therapist checks your hair and scalp and helps you choose a cream, then applies it from roots to ends. A slow scalp massage works it in and eases tension, and a rinse and finish leave your hair soft and easy to manage.
featuresLeft: Cream application from roots to ends
featuresRight: Available at the spa or through home service

items.question: How is a cream bath different from a hair mask?
items.answer: Both nourish the hair, but a cream bath treats the scalp as well as the strands, with a relaxing scalp massage that helps work the cream evenly through the hair. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak you can choose either: the Hair Mask and most cream bath formulas are IDR 165.000 per person, and L'Oreal is IDR 195.000.

items.question: Is a cream bath suitable for coloured or chemically treated hair?
items.answer: Yes. Cream baths at Spa Bali Moon are suitable for coloured, highlighted and chemically treated hair. Your therapist starts with a hair and scalp assessment and can recommend the best formula: Ginseng, Avocado, Aloe Vera, NR, Hair Mask or L'Oreal.

items.question: Which cream bath is best for dry hair?
items.answer: Many guests with dry hair choose the Avocado or L'Oreal cream bath at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak. Avocado is chosen for moisture and softness, and L'Oreal for smoother, more manageable hair. Your therapist assesses your hair first and can suggest the better match.

items.question: How often should I get a cream bath?
items.answer: Many people book a cream bath every two to four weeks, depending on their hair and how often they style it. In Bali, guests often add one after sun, salt water or swimming.

items.question: Can I have a cream bath after swimming or a day at the beach?
items.answer: Yes. A cream bath is one of the most popular treatments after swimming, salt water or sun, because it helps restore moisture and softness to the hair. At Spa Bali Moon you can have one at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.

items.question: Does a cream bath include a scalp massage?
items.answer: Yes. Every cream bath at Spa Bali Moon includes a relaxing scalp and head massage. After the cream is applied from roots to ends, the massage works it through the hair and scalp while you unwind. It finishes with a rinse.

items.question: How is a cream bath different from a regular hair wash?
items.answer: A regular hair wash mainly cleanses the hair and scalp, while a cream bath is a deeper conditioning and relaxation treatment. At Spa Bali Moon, a cream bath combines a nourishing hair cream applied from roots to ends with a relaxing scalp massage, then a rinse, so it offers both hair care and relaxation.

items.question: Should I wash my hair before a cream bath?
items.answer: No. You generally do not need to wash your hair before a cream bath at Spa Bali Moon. Your therapist assesses your hair and scalp as part of the treatment. Just avoid applying excessive styling products beforehand so the cream can be applied and massaged in comfortably.

items.question: How much does a cream bath cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: A cream bath at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak is IDR 165.000 per person for the Ginseng, Avocado, Aloe Vera, NR and Hair Mask formulas, and IDR 195.000 for L'Oreal. Four packages from IDR 480.000 per person add a massage, facial, body scrub or reflexology. Home service adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area.

items.question: Where can I get a cream bath or hair spa in Seminyak?
items.answer: You can get a cream bath or hair spa at Spa Bali Moon, Jl. Pangkung Sari No. 30, Seminyak, open daily from 9am to 11pm, or at your villa or hotel for an extra IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area.

items.question: How long does a cream bath take?
items.answer: A cream bath at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak takes 30 to 60 minutes and costs IDR 165.000 per person, or IDR 195.000 with L'Oreal. In a spa package it takes 45 to 55 minutes.

items.question: Can I have a cream bath at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes from our Seminyak spa to your villa, hotel or home with fresh linen and everything a cream bath needs. It costs the same as at the spa, plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta.

items.question: Can I book a cream bath for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 between 9am and 11pm with the time you'd like. At our Seminyak spa we confirm the next free time; at a villa or hotel in the Seminyak area a therapist usually arrives within 30 to 60 minutes. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my cream bath?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your cream bath on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
